pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular, multi-lobed polygonal regions with soft edge gradients. Patch shapes on the neck exhibit star-like extensions, while flank patches are more consolidated with higher spatial area.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Cream-colored interstitial lattice with high continuity. Junction nodes are thick and well-defined, with pathway widths approximately 20-30% of the diameter of adjacent dark patches.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Fine-textured, low-amplitude serration visible along the upper neck silhouette, though partially occluded by external objects.

other_distinctive_markers: Four avian organisms (oxpeckers) are perched along the dorsal ridge of the neck, creating non-biological protrusions on the primary silhouette.
